summary.en: Experimental desktop app for running local LLMs, with a Windows ARM64 installer (strata_Zackyzq_0.2.8_arm64-setup.exe, release v0.2.8-n1x.1), run by its maintainer on one N1X 128GB laptop.
summary.zh-TW: 本機執行 LLM 的實驗性桌面應用程式，提供 Windows ARM64 安裝程式（strata_Zackyzq_0.2.8_arm64-setup.exe，release v0.2.8-n1x.1），維護者在一台 N1X 128GB 筆電上執行。

caveats.en: Results come from one maintainer-owned laptop and are self-reported; other N1X laptops are not validated.
caveats.zh-TW: 結果來自維護者自己的一台筆電，由作者自行回報；其他 N1X 筆電未驗證。

caveats.en: Experimental preview; the installer is unsigned and includes no model weights or NVIDIA drivers.
caveats.zh-TW: 實驗性預覽版；安裝程式未簽署，且不含模型權重與 NVIDIA 驅動程式。

evidence.title: strata-n1x README and release v0.2.8-n1x.1: Windows ARM64 installer, tested on one N1X laptop
